items: 2 × 3.4 oz packages instant pudding (vanilla or chocolate)

steps.title: Cream the butter and sugars
steps.body: Cream together **2 cups softened butter**, **1½ cups brown sugar** and **½ cup white sugar**.

steps.title: Mix in the dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix until integrated: **2 × 3.4 oz packages instant pudding (vanilla or chocolate)**, **4½ cups flour** and **2 tsp baking soda**.

steps.title: Add the mix-ins
steps.body: Add **4 cups chocolate chips** and **2 cups nuts**, and if you really want to bug Levi, some dried fruit as well.

steps.title: Drop and bake
steps.body: Drop by spoon onto a baking pan. Bake at 350°F for 10–12 minutes, until the edges are golden brown.
